identificationModule.briefTitle: Lipo-dox and Cyclophosphamide /5-Fluorouracil in Patients With Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Study of Pegylated Liposomal Doxorubicin (Lipo-Dox) Combined With Cyclophosphamide /5-Fluorouracil as Second Line Chemotherapy in the Treatment of Metastatic Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To determine the overall objective response rate of pegylated liposomal doxorubicin （Lipo-Dox）combined with cyclophosphamide/5-FU as second-line treatment in patients with metastatic breast cancer.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* histologically proved breast cancer with metastatic disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* life expectancy less than 3 months.
